_comment: Announced Global release dates for JP-ahead uma records (P5). Added 2026-08-12. WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: these umas are live (or dated) on Global, but the upstream cutover set that normally flips a record to server:'global' is gone — jalbarrang/umalator-global was renamed to torena-sim and stripped of all game data on 2026-08-09 (provenance §1.3), so a pin bump can no longer pull them in. Setting an ANNOUNCED (releaseDatePredicted:false) date makes availabilityTier return 'now' once elapsed while the record stays server:'jp', which is exactly the mechanism the planning horizon was built for. Records stay server:'jp' deliberately — this file dates them, it does not claim they came from the Global cutover. Outfit identity was confirmed by epithet, not inferred from the id. Source: uma.guide August 2026 release schedule (https://uma.guide/guides/release-schedule-august26), cross-checked against Game8's August 2026 schedule. Dates are banner-open dates. NOT included: anything whose date the sources hedge as 'expected' rather than announced (P3).

102901._comment: Yukino Bijin [Darl'n Snowflake] — new uma, banner Aug 5-13. Epithet matches the banner name in both sources exactly.

108701._comment: Aston Machan [Flare] — new uma, banner Aug 25-Sep 2. Future-dated on purpose: an announced future date is 'upcoming', which is correct, and it lets a CM18-horizon plan include her.
